quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2025 revenue RMB 1,546,758,347.74, up 12.26% (2024: RMB 1,377,818,293.49); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 298,963,613.77, up 14.43%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 281,038,776.09, up 12.61%; operating cash flow RMB 152,047,743.77, down 17.23%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 370,555,568.42, Q2 RMB 457,923,810.04, Q3 RMB 385,806,498.86, Q4 RMB 332,472,470.42 (Q4 net profit RMB 38,630,258.30). quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2025 optical device products revenue RMB 1,515,272,335.05 (97.96% of revenue, up 14.74%) at a 38.31% gross margin, up 3.83 pt. Exports RMB 1,196,176,250.95 (77.33%, up 10.80%, gross margin 41.34%); domestic sales RMB 350,582,096.79 (up 17.57%, gross margin 26.63%). Optical device sales to North America, its main revenue source: 72,355,113 units, RMB 1,092,907,312.21. quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2025 optical device products: capacity 27,702.55 ten-thousand units (2024: 27,070); per the sales-volume table, output 25,633.9 ten-thousand units (up 0.01%), sales 23,843.81 ten-thousand (down 1.08%), year-end inventory 10,580.69 ten-thousand (up 20.36%). In 2025 it expanded its domestic production base, ramped capacity at its Vietnam plant, and pushed MMC / MDC (miniature multi-fiber / dual-fiber connector) products through trial production, customer qualification and volume production.

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2025 R&D status: 800G and 1.6T high-speed optical modules / AOCs have product development basically complete, targeting volume sales; FAU products for optical modules and CPO basically met project goals; AWG chips and devices are in small-batch trial production; key-technology R&D for an ultra-high-density optical backplane for AI servers is complete and awaiting acceptance; MDC, LC Uniboot and ultra-low-loss 12F MPO connectors are in volume sales; fiber-routing flexible board products met their goals and high-speed MT ferrules are in scale use. It co-develops fiber-routing schemes based on its flexible boards with domestic and overseas makers.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G and 1.6T optical modules / AOCs development basically complete

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2025 R&D expense RMB 76,608,911.28, up 8.45%, mainly on performance pay and share-based payment; R&D staff 286 (up 21.19%, 11.39% of employees). The company says it has a vertically integrated chain from core materials to devices and systems; in 2025 it bought out the minority holders of ceramic powder and ceramic ferrule maker Jingdezhen Hechuan (to 100%, registration change in progress) and added capital to its optoelectronic device subsidiary Tesilu.

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: T&S Communications 2026 business plan (annual report): R&D focus on production automation equipment, CPO-related products and process optimisation for active-module accessory products; add production space and scale in steps for ceramic ferrules, MPO and standard patch cords, MMC and MDC high-density connectors and module jumpers, and plan higher-fiber-count jumper lines; advance customer qualification and order transfer at its Vietnam plant; secure optical fiber supply and localise supply in Vietnam. With AI demand it targets key customers with higher-fiber-count MPO connectors, MMC/MDC connectors, high-fiber-count MT ferrules, active and accessory products, fiber-routing flexible boards for CPO and AWG products, and 'strives to achieve substantial business growth'.
